tool_args.rationale: The initial barrier law failed decisively. The open-branch probe adds two high-contrast sink-gradient observations, while all rows remain at the same short horizon and state, pointing to the archived static inland-hub siphon family rather than a horizon-dependent model. Numerically fit the sink inhibition and compare the archived branch variants; no nuisance measurement is relevant.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Direct fit was refuted on fresh confirmation with RMSE 3.78, far above tolerance.
